name: Photo Dump
summary: A carousel of 6 to 20 casual photos in one post: blurred, flash-lit, off-centre, with a screenshot, a meal and a mirror selfie in a row. It looks careless on purpose.

philosophy.core_thesis: The opposite of the curated grid: show the camera roll as it is, so that the poster looks relaxed and real.
design_principles: Post 6 to 20 images in one carousel, up to 10 on the first apps and 20 on later ones.
Mix formats: a 4:5 portrait, a 1:1 square, a screenshot and a short clip, with no shared preset.
Allow blur, red-eye, hard flash and a tilt of 3° to 10° in at least 3 images.
Add a pale dotted pager of 6 dots under the post and a count badge such as 1/12 at the top right.
Open with the best photo and end with the funniest, such as a pet or a blurry mirror.
Set the caption in 1 line, lower case, with an emoji or a date such as 'feb dump'.
Overlay a sticker or a hand-written word in marker at 24px to 40px on 1 or 2 images.
anti_patterns: Perfect exposure and sharp focus in every frame
A text tile that looks like an advertisement

layout.grid_mechanics: A swipe row of mixed-ratio images in one card of 1080px width; a pager and a count badge overlay the frame.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 10% to 20% stays empty; the spacing scale is 4, 8, 12 and 24px.
layout.alignment_rules: The first image centres; later images vary in crop; stickers sit off the grid with a tilt of 3° to 10°.
layout.container_geometry: Images with a 0px to 8px radius; a count badge of 40px by 24px with a 12px radius; a dot pager of 6px dots.

font_pairings.note: A marker face for a hand-written word on a photo.
A quirky grotesque for a casual title.
A rough hand-written face for a short caption.

typography.tracking: Display takes 0em; the count badge takes +0.04em.
hierarchy_rules: Use at most 2 hand-written words on one image.

color.palette_structure: A near-black feed ground with flash white, one sticker yellow and one blown red; photo colours vary.
color.contrast_rules: Text on the near-black card holds at least 12:1; yellow and red carry stickers, badges and the active dot.
color.surface_treatment: A flat dark card; photos keep their own colour; a light grain of 4% on stickers.
color.light_and_shadow: Hard on-camera flash in the photos, with a bright subject and a dark background; no gloss on chrome.

materiality.surface_simulation: A phone camera roll: screenshots, flash snaps and blur in one swipe row.
materiality.border_rules: No border on photos; a 1px #2A2A2D line on the card.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: A 12px blur on the count badge background at 50% opacity; no cast shadow.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Solid icons at 24px: heart, comment, send and save, with round ends.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Hand-drawn circles, arrows and scribbled words in marker over some photos; sticker emojis.

motion.transition_physics: Images swipe at 280ms with a rubber stop; the dot pager scales the active dot to 150% in 150ms; stickers pop in at 200ms.
motion.hover_and_active: A swipe moves the pager; a double tap shows a heart at 120% scale for 400ms.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels close to the poster, as at a casual look at a friend's phone.

use_cases: brand posts that need a human voice
avoid_when: The page must show a strict, formal brand.
The photos are product shots that need true colour.
The reader needs one clear message.

modifiers.how: Apply one preset, crop to squares and lay the images in a 3-column grid.
Reduce to one image with a front and back view and a time stamp.
Add a light leak, grain and pastel tints on a dark ground.

pack.why: A soft, solid family that matches the round buttons of a phone carousel.

ground.why: The ground is a stack of mixed-size blocks: images of different ratios side by side.
